description: This file defines the interface PolicyEntry, representing a single entry in a policy, including methods to create instances, retrieve label, subjects, resources, supported schema versions, and convert to JSON. It also contains nested static class JsonFields defining JSON field definitions specific to PolicyEntry.

classes.name: PolicyEntry
classes.description: An interface representing a single policy entry with methods to access label, subjects, resources, supported schema versions, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: PolicyEntry.JsonFields
classes.description: A static nested class defining JSON field definitions for PolicyEntry, including schema version, subjects, and resources fields.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry instance with specified label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions that support PolicyEntry (only V_2).

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of this PolicyEntry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the subjects associated with this PolicyEntry.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the resources associated with this PolicyEntry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representation of this PolicyEntry with non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representation of this PolicyEntry for a specific schema version and field selector.
